author: xjamesmode
quote:
Not worth buying this game. 
Terrible fps. 
The writing is bad. It's like some amateur wrote this story.
The characters don't draw you in & the missions feel like a checklist instead of a journey. There's not many memorable moments in the game & the game doesn't make you feel anything.
It's basically a Red Dead Redemption game wearing a GTA mask.
Graphics are good & the world feels alive but that's about where it stops with the positives.

The previous GTA titles are doing the heavy lifting as to why people are playing this game. Without the previous titles & branding, this game is just another mediocre game.

author: xjamesmode
quote:
Greatest game of all time.
Great story. Everything is memorable. The game makes you feel something at all times throughout your play-through.
Visually stunning. Responsive gameplay.
A game you must experience.
